## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the squash commit)
- [ ] `make validate` passes locally, and `make smoke` for the profiles this touches
- [ ] Images are pinned to a version, never `latest`
- [ ] New settings are in `.env.example`, and secrets are generated by `scripts/setup-env`, never committed
- [ ] `docs/architecture.md` reflects the change
- [ ] New decisions have an ADR; substantial proposals had an RFC
